posts.description: This thing still works perfectly after 24 years.
Nia always pauses to enjoy flowers.

I’m grateful to travel for work but I don’t get to do much personal stuff while away. This time in Melbourne, I was lucky to see an exciting 92–92 draw between Hawthorn and Collingwood at the MCG and watch The Odyssey in 70mm at the Astor Theatre. Awesome!
